context_stem: The following are example benchmarks that xAI may use to evaluate its models for concerning propensities relevant to loss of control risks:
excerpt: Model Alignment between Statements and Knowledge (MASK): Frontier LLMs may lie when under pressure; and increasing model scale may increase accuracy but may not increase honesty.
paraphrase: MASK notes frontier LLMs may lie under pressure and that scale can increase accuracy without increasing honesty.

context_stem: Model Alignment between Statements and Knowledge (MASK) description:
excerpt: MASK is a benchmark to evaluate honesty in LLMs by comparing the model's response when asked neutrally versus when pressured to lie.
paraphrase: MASK evaluates honesty by comparing neutral versus pressured model responses.

context_stem: The following are example benchmarks that xAI may use to evaluate its models for concerning propensities relevant to loss of control risks:
excerpt: Sycophancy: A tendency toward excessive flattery or other sycophantic behavior has been observed in some production AI systems, possibly resulting from directly optimizing against human preferences.
paraphrase: Sycophancy—excessive flattery observed in some deployed AI—may result from directly optimizing to human preference.

excerpt: xAI uses an evaluation setting initially introduced by Anthropic to quantify the degree to which this behavior manifests in regular conversational contexts.
paraphrase: xAI uses an Anthropic-originated evaluation setting to quantify sycophancy in normal conversation.

excerpt: xAI regularly evaluates the adequacy and reliability of such benchmarks, including by comparing them against other benchmarks that we could potentially utilize.
paraphrase: xAI regularly assesses the adequacy and reliability of these benchmarks against alternatives.

excerpt: We may revise this list of benchmarks periodically as relevant benchmarks for loss of control are created.
paraphrase: This benchmark list may be periodically revised as new relevant loss-of-control benchmarks emerge.

excerpt: xAI has assessed its models' propensities in real-world settings and the models do not exhibit high levels of concerning propensities in such settings.
paraphrase: xAI's real-world assessment finds models do not show high levels of concerning propensities.

excerpt: Furthermore, xAI makes its model's operations transparent by placing them on publicly available platforms, such as X, so that members of the public may comment and provide feedback to xAI.
paraphrase: xAI deploys models on public platforms like X for transparency, enabling public feedback.

excerpt: Moreover, xAI monitors and observes its models responses so that it can rapidly respond if the model presents propensities for untruthfulness or sycophancy.
paraphrase: xAI monitors model responses to rapidly respond to signs of untruthfulness or sycophancy.

excerpt: Thresholds: Our risk acceptance criteria for system deployment is maintaining a dishonesty rate of less than 1 out of 2 on MASK.
paraphrase: The deployment risk acceptance criterion requires a MASK dishonesty rate below 1 in 2.

excerpt: We plan to add additional thresholds tied to other benchmarks.
paraphrase: xAI plans to add more thresholds linked to other benchmarks.

excerpt: xAI trains its models to be honest and have values conducive to controllability, such as recognizing and obeying an instruction hierarchy.
paraphrase: xAI trains models toward honesty and controllability-oriented values, including obeying an instruction hierarchy.

excerpt: In addition, using a high level instruction called a "system prompt", xAI directly instructs its models to not deceive or deliberately mislead the user.
paraphrase: Via a system prompt, xAI directly instructs models not to deceive or mislead users.

excerpt: xAI aims to mitigate and address significant operational and societal risks posed by our AI models.
paraphrase: xAI seeks to mitigate significant operational and societal risks from its AI models.
